research.note: Animated shadcn/ui components and landing sections, including WebGL dither heroes and an iPhone-style Dynamic Island.

effects: Hero Dithering: split hero with a WebGL dithering shader
Dynamic Island: composable iPhone Dynamic Island that morphs between size presets

unverified: The components are in the public repository nolly-studio/cult-ui (MIT, last commit 2026-10-14); that repository has not been researched yet.
Pricing is freemium because the site also sells paid AI SDK Agents blocks (marked PAID, one-time purchase); the components themselves are free.
